description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jayden Daniels is expected to be a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Daniels was seen throwing during practice. He remains hopeful to return on Sunday against the Giants.
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) expected to log full practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. was seen on a scooter in the Steelers locker room.
items.impact: It appears to be a foot injury for Pittman. He has been off the fantasy radar when healthy in his current role in the Steelers offense.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. seen on scooter in Steelers locker room

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Texans OT Braden Smith returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith opened the season on injured reserve. He will have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Braden Smith (foot) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Texans DT Kayden McDonald returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McDonald was a second-round pick this year and has been out with an ankle injury. He will have 21 days to be activated.
items.title: Kayden McDonald returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordan Addison is not practicing on Wednesday due to soreness.
items.impact: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell called the situation "minor" for Addison. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Jordan Addison (soreness) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Justin Jefferson will practice in limited fashion on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jefferson is hopeful to return in Week 5. Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said he's "doing well" with the ankle injury.
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) to be limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens have added TE Nick Vannett to the 53-man roster.
items.impact: Vannett takes the roster spot of Durham Smythe as the primary blocking tight end for Baltimore.
items.title: Nick Vannett added to Ravens 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars placed S Eric Murray in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Murray will likely be sidelined in Week 5 for Jacksonville.
items.title: Eric Murray placed in concussion protocol

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tank Dell has been designated to return from injured reserve.
items.impact: Dell is coming off back-to-back season-ending injuries. He will have the next 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cade Mays made his return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mays broke his wrist during training camp. He can be activated at any point in the next 21 days.
items.title: Cade Mays (wrist) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brian Branch was back at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Branch tore his Achilles last season and has been on the physically unable to perform list since the start of training camp. He can be activated at any point in the next 21 days.
items.title: Brian Branch (Achilles) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chris Brooks will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brooks underwent tests on an ankle injury he suffered this past weekend. He remains day-to-day for now.
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed QB Mark Gronowski to their active roster.
items.impact: Gronkowski will add depth in the quarterback room for Houston.
items.title: Mark Gronowski signs with Texans' active roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rachaad White returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: White remains hopeful to return this week against the Giants.
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ben Sinnott practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sinnott remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.
items.title: Ben Sinnott (rib) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sam Cosmi practiced in a black non-contact jersey on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cosmi remains hopeful to return in Week 5 for the Commanders.
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion) practices in non-contact jersey Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders opened the practice window of Deatrich Wise Jr.
items.impact: Wise will have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Deatrich Wise Jr. (quad) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders opened the practice window of RB Jeremy McNichols.
items.impact: McNichols will add depth in the backfield for Washington when he is activated.
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (quad) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders opened the practice window for Trey Amos.
items.impact: Amos will have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Trey Amos has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Terry McLaurin will practice off to the side on Wednesday.
items.impact: McLaurin remains up in the air to return in Week 5.
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) practicing off to side Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed QB Jake Haener to their 53-man roster off their practice squad.
items.impact: Haener will be the QB3 for the Giants behind Jameis Winston and JJ McCarthy.
items.title: Jake Haener signs with Giants 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Caleb Douglas will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Douglas is "doing better" but he isn't quite ready to return to practice yet. He may miss another game in Week 5.
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rico Dowdle went through warmups in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dowdle did not participate in individual drills. His status will need to be monitored on the injury report.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) goes through warmups in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Mason Taylor is fine to return to practice.
items.impact: Taylor will remain in his depth role in the Jets tight end room when he is healthy.
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) cleared to return to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Dylan Parham is week-to-week.
items.impact: Parham is continuing to work his way back from a knee injury.
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) week-to-week

title: Fantasy Player News
